task: Welcome to TextWorld! Here is how to play! First step, assure that the gateway is wide open. Once you have pulled open the gateway, attempt to venture east. Then, take a trip north. That done, pick up the mug from the floor of the cookery. And once you've done that, you win!
description:
You find yourself in a cubicle. A standard kind of place.

You can make out an armchair. What a coincidence, weren't you just thinking about an armchair? The armchair is usual. But the thing is empty, unfortunately. Oh! Why couldn't there just be stuff on it?

There is a closed gateway leading east. There is an open portal leading west.

thought: I should first assure that the gateway leading east is wide open by pulling it open if it is closed.
